newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN shares suspended limit-up third time.
newsitem.headline: GAN shares suspended limit-up third time.

text.p: Shares in French state-controlled insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales were suspended limit up for a third time on the Paris stock exchange on Friday after briefly requoting.
Limit up regulations kick in when a share surges more than 10 percent. Under the regulations, there is a "time out" of 15 minutes and new upper limits are set each time for the share.
The SBF stock markets association said a new attempt to requote would be made at 0950 GMT. The share briefly requoted up 17.89 percent at 145 francs before the third suspension.
